description: Schema for hotel loyalty programs that publish a category-banded award chart with off-peak / standard / peak point bands per category (e.g. Marriott Bonvoy Cat 1-8, Hilton Honors, IHG One Rewards, Hyatt Cat 1-8, Wyndham). Some programs use a single point cost per category instead of three bands; in that case standard_points is set and off_peak_points/peak_points are 0.

categories.description: One entry per award category. Order by category number ascending.

off_peak_points.description: Off-peak / saver point cost per night. Set to 0 if the program does not have an off-peak band.

standard_points.description: Standard / regular point cost per night. Required.

peak_points.description: Peak point cost per night. Set to 0 if the program does not have a peak band.

all_inclusive_categories.description: Optional second chart for all-inclusive resort categories if the program publishes them separately (Marriott + Hilton both do).

pricing_methodology.description: Plain-English summary of how the program determines off-peak / standard / peak (typically demand-based, set ~12 months in advance, with a calendar surfaced on each property page).

fifth_night_free.description: Whether and how a 5th-night-free benefit applies to award stays under this chart. Set to 'none' if not offered.

booking_fees_summary.description: Plain-English summary of any taxes, resort fees, change/cancel rules, and notable constraints on award redemptions per the chart page T&C section.
